d: Kainsar ki davaon ki kimton men bhari kami ke phaisle ka jharkhand men vyapak svagat kiya ja raha hai. marijon ne is rahat ke lie kendr sarkar ke prati aabhar jataya hai, vahin chikitsakon ne ise kainsar ke ilaj ko adhik sulabh aur kiphayti banane ki disha men krantikari kadam bataya hai. dusri or, rajy men parv-tyoharon ko lekar bhaktimay mahaul bana huaa hai. govardhan puja, sohray aur bandna parv ke avsar par log sukh-samriddhi aur khushhali ki kamna kar rahe hain. vahin, man kali ke darbar men bhi bari sankhya men shraddhalu pahunchkar puja-archana kar rahe hain. idhar, raksha rajy…
